enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +12: Passive: +12 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Potency +52: Passive: +52 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Concentration +14: Passive: +14 Competence bonus to the Concentration skill.
Healing Lore +12: Passive: Your Positive Energy spells gain a 12% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Fragmented: This item looks as though it is only one half of a greater item. Perhaps in the future it could be rejoined with its other half to reform the item in its original glory.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
